(Capacity: 3,005) |champion=[[Las Vegas Invitational (basketball)|Las Vegas Invitational]] champions |tourney=[[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2021–22 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of San Francisco]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Dons were led by third-year head coach [[Todd Golden]], and played their home games at the [[The Sobrato Center|War Memorial Gymnasium at the Sobrato Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. USF began the season at 10–0, which marked the program's best start to a season since they opened with 26 straight wins in 1976–77.{{cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/court-report-how-unbeaten-colorado-state-and-san-francisco-became-mid-major-cinderella-candidates-this-season/|title=Court Report: How unbeaten Colorado State and San Francisco became mid-major Cinderella candidates this season|last=Norlander|first=Matt|date=17 December 2021|website=[[CBSSports.com]]|access-date=29 December 2021}}{{cite news|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/sports/college/article/How-a-36-year-old-up-and-comer-is-helping-restore-16663139.php|title=How a 36-year-old up-and-comer is helping restore USF basketball's greatness|last=Letourneau|first=Connor|date=30 November 2021|work=[[San Francisco Examiner]]|access-date=29 December 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://usfdons.com/news/2021/11/26/mens-basketball-usf-crowned-las-vegas-invitational-champions.aspx|title=USF Crowned Las Vegas Invitational Champions|date=26 November 2021|publisher=[[University of San Francisco]] Athletics|website=USFDons.com|access-date=29 December 2021}} The Dons' perfect season ended with a one-point loss to [[2021–22 Grand Canyon Antelopes men's basketball team|Grand Canyon]] on December 18; they would ultimately wrap up their non-conference slate with a 13–2 record heading into WCC play. The Dons finished conference regular season play at 10–6 and were seeded fourth in that year's [[2022 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]]. After a win against BYU and a loss to Gonzaga, the Dons received an at-large NCAA tournament bid, their first appearance since 1998. They were placed as a tenth seed in the East region but lost in an overtime game to seventh seed [[2021–22 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]] 92–87. The day after the tournament loss, March 18, 2022, head coach Todd Golden accepted the head coach role at [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]].{{Cite web|url=https://floridagators.com/news/2022/3/18/mens-basketball-todd-golden-named-florida-mens-basketball-head-coach.aspx|title=Todd Golden Named Florida Men's Basketball Head Coach}} [[Chris Gerlufsen]] was subsequently named the next head coach. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|Dons]] concluded the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 11–14, 4–9 in [[2020–21 West Coast Conference men's basketball season|WCC play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2020–21 San Diego Toreros men's basketball team|San Diego]] in the first round of the [[2021 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Loyola Marymount Lions men's basketball team|Loyola Marymount]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
